exposure: Availability of emergency obstetric and neonatal care (EmONC) components
outcome: Maternal mortality due to direct obstetric causes
cohort: Women giving birth in 53 health facilities providing maternity care in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo
finding: The availability of EmONC in Lubumbashi falls short of WHO standards, with only one facility providing comprehensive EmONC, leading to high maternal and intrapartum mortality.
